title: 第537章 喜羊羊留下的字条
slug: 规则怪谈从诡异哆啦a梦开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

红太狼的脸色仍旧苍白。

她从红色的大衣里，拿出了一张字条。

林远接过字条后，没有第一时间去看，而是顺手放在了一旁。

“红红，喜羊羊留下的字条我不感兴趣。”

“现在你躺着，我给你去抓几只青蛙和鱼回来，给你补补身体。”

林远转头就走，一副毫不在意的表情。

看到这一幕，红太狼心底暖暖的。

“灰太狼......你看到了小灰灰吧？”

就在林远快踏出卧室门的时候，红太狼叫住了他。

林远停下了脚步，没有说话。

气氛沉闷起来。

片刻后，林远柔声开口道：

“红红，你应该早点告诉我，让小灰灰身体恢复的关键是你的血。”

“如果我早点知道，我可以通过你的一滴血研制出效果更好的道具。”

“说不定小灰灰......就能早点醒过来。”

“当然，我并没有怪你，只是我......心疼你。”

爱一个人的最高境界是共情心疼，林远觉得，爱一只狼也是。

身后的红太狼嘴角向上勾去，眉眼弯弯。

即使她现在看上去极其虚弱，但她真的很开心。

因为灰太狼的好，从不是开始就这样，而是一如既往。

一只狼可能会开始对你好，对你温柔，但随着时间的流逝，他一定会改变。

这种改变，是熟悉了之后的倦怠感。

可是......灰太狼却从未觉得厌烦，而是一直在为红太狼考虑。

“灰太狼，你还是这样，遇到难解决的事，要自己承担。”

红太狼脸上浮现出了一丝满足。

林远转过身，摇了摇头：

“红红，是你值得。”

“况且，如果不是你一直在家里等着我，我又怎么会天天去捉羊呢？”

“因为我知道，失败后的狼堡，有你和小灰灰在。”

“若是你因为我捉不到羊真的离开我，那我的生活可就失去了意义。”

林远的话很轻，却是他从灰太狼与红太狼的感情中分析出的道理。

若不是红太狼一直没有走，灰太狼还有不折不扣坚持下去的理由吗？

他曾在蓝星看到过两条新闻。

第一条是某地下了一场很大的雨，丈夫因为实在太冷，就提前结束了跑外卖，赶回了家取暖。

可回到家躺在沙发上吃水果的妻子，看到丈夫回来后，当即破口大骂。

原因很简单，同行都在拼命跑，为什么你不行？

丈夫无奈沉默，最终选择了去跑外卖，在大雨中，他出了车祸。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Red Wolf's face was still pale.

She took out a note from her red coat.

After Lin Yuan took the note, he did not read it immediately, but put it aside.

"Honghong, I'm not interested in the note left by Pleasant Goat."

"Now you lie down, and I will catch some frogs and fish for you to replenish your health."

Lin Yuan turned around and left with an unconcerned expression.

Seeing this scene, Red Wolf felt warm in his heart.

"Big Big Wolf...you saw little Hui Hui, right?"

Just when Lin Yuan was about to step out of the bedroom door, Red Wolf stopped him.

Lin Yuan stopped and said nothing.

The atmosphere became dull.

After a while, Lin Yuan spoke softly:

"Honghong, you should have told me earlier that the key to Xiao Huihui's recovery is your blood."

"If I knew earlier, I could use a drop of your blood to develop props with better effects."

"Maybe Xiao Huihui... can wake up early."

"Of course, I don't blame you, it's just that I... feel sorry for you."

The highest state of loving a person is empathy and sympathy. Lin Yuan feels that the same is true for loving a wolf.

The red wolf behind him raised the corners of his mouth and arched his eyebrows.

Even though she looks extremely frail right now, she's really happy.

Because Big Big Wolf is so good, it has never been like this from the beginning, but has always been the same.

A wolf may start out being nice and gentle to you, but over time, he will definitely change.

This change is the feeling of fatigue after becoming familiar with it.

But...the gray wolf never felt bored, but was always thinking about the red wolf.

"Big Big Wolf, you are still like this. When you encounter difficult problems, you have to bear them yourself."

A trace of satisfaction appeared on Red Wolf's face.

Lin Yuan turned around and shook his head:

"Honghong, you are worth it."

"Besides, if you hadn't been waiting for me at home, how could I catch sheep every day?"

"Because I know that you and Xiao Huihui will be there in Wolfsburg after the failure."

"If you really leave me because I can't catch the sheep, then my life will be meaningless."

Lin Yuan's words were very soft, but they were the truth he analyzed from the relationship between Gray Wolf and Red Wolf.

If Red Wolf hadn't left, would Gray Wolf still have a reason to persist?

He had seen two pieces of news on Blue Star.

The first one is that it rained heavily somewhere. Because it was too cold, my husband ended his takeaway run early and rushed home to keep warm.

But when the wife returned home and was lying on the sofa eating fruit, she immediately cursed when she saw her husband coming back.

The reason is simple. Your peers are running hard, why can’t you?

The husband was helpless and silent, and finally chose to go for a takeaway. In the heavy rain, he had a car accident.
